summary.en:
- Whenever allies gain or consume Skill Points, Rin Tohsaka gains "Gem Energy". If she has 15 or more "Gem Energy", or if the team has more than 7 Skill Points, she can use her Enhanced Skill. This Enhanced Skill deals increased damage based on her current "Gem Energy" and consumes all Skill Points except for two.
- Rin Tohsaka's performance is heavily reliant on Sparkle and Cerydra. Sparkle provides the Skill Points needed for more "Gem Energy". Cerydra can duplicate the powerful Enhanced Skill.

details.en:
- S1 [[light-cone:flickering-stars]] grants Rin Tohsaka CRIT Rate, Skill DMG, and a teamwide DEF Ignore buff. This provides a significant boost to Main DPS Rin.
- E1 allows her to utilize a new resource called "Shadow Gem" in addition to her normal "Gem Energy" and Skill Points. This makes her bursts of Skill DMG much more consistent, greatly increasing her personal DPS.
- E2 increases Rin Tohsaka's personal Skill DMG while also increasing the Skill multiplier for all allies. This is a significant increase to her own damage.
